hypotheses.reasoning: The cause is one malformed message on events.raw partition 0: msg-263454 at offset 197049 has a NUL byte at position 1367, so it can't be parsed as JSON. Because no max-retries is configured, the processor keeps nacking and redelivering it (attempt 8 by 04:49:20) and gets the same error each time. That blocks the partition. Lag on partition 0 climbs from 85s at 04:50:50 to more than 880s by 05:00. CPU stays normal because the consumer is stuck on one message, not overloaded.

Postgres ran out of disk at about the same time (04:49), and order-service inserts failed with DiskFullError. This affects the orders path, not the events.raw consumer, so it is probably a separate issue happening at the same time.

verdict.recommendedAction: Skip or dead-letter msg-263454 (events.raw partition 0, offset 197049) so the consumer can move past it. Then configure a max-retry count and a dead-letter queue (DLQ) in event-processor so one bad message can't block a partition again, and check the producer to find out why a NUL byte ended up in the payload. Separately, free up disk on postgres.
